read.thesis: UBS Q2 2026 is a strong wealth and IB quarter with pretax up 45% and CET1 at 14.4%, but it is a capital-return and earnings story rather than a supply-side cycle signal; the $3bn buyback runs to Q2 2027 with a CET1 ~14% floor and Swiss capital rules as conditions.

triggers.label: GWM NII FY26 ~10% growth
triggers.quote: We now expect full year 2026 GWM net interest income to grow by around 10% versus 2025

triggers.label: Cost synergies $12.6bn → $13.5bn target
triggers.quote: we remain firmly on track to achieve our $13.5 billion ambition by the end of this year

triggers.label: Americas WM adviser exits lag
triggers.quote: we recognize there's a lag effect from previously announced FA movement that will continue to show up in flows for a few quarters

guidance.quote: We now expect full year 2026 GWM net interest income to grow by around 10% versus 2025
we expect integration-related expenses in the second half to be around $750 million
we now expect P&C's full year CLE to come in below our previous estimate of around CHF 300 million
we now expect the 2026 exit rate for NCL operating expenses, excluding litigation, to be around $400 million

guidance.value: at least $1bn in next 3 months; $3bn by end Q2 2027
guidance.quote: we intend to buy back $3 billion of shares at the latest by the end of the second quarter 2027

red_flags.label: US WM adviser exits continuing
red_flags.quote: we recognize there's a lag effect from previously announced FA movement that will continue to show up in flows for a few quarters

red_flags.label: Asia equities volumes unlikely to sustain
red_flags.quote: the very strong performance in volumes that we saw in Asia in the second quarter and the first quarter for that matter is unlikely to continue at that level

evasions.quote: We'll come back on the details on that one, Stefan.
specifically in terms of anything regarding 2028, we'll update you as part of our fourth quarter strategic update early next year
